J&K Police Search 26 Locations Linked to Terror Case in Sopore

Jammu and Kashmir Police conducted searches at 26 locations in Sopore, north Kashmir, on Tuesday. The searches are linked to a terror case and targeted properties associated with the Jamaat-e-Islami. The operation was carried out by the Sopore police.
